# documentService

## Access

| Option             | Value                                                                                                       |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Row policy         | `jsonAcl`: the level the `acl` column lists for the user, and Admin for the user the `ownerId` column names |
| Service-wide Admin | passes every check of the service                                                                           |
| Change topic       | closed: the service declares no `watchAccess`                                                               |
| Field levels       | none: every caller who may read a row receives all of it                                                    |

Each method below says who may call it.

## Entity

| Field       | Type                                                                               | Notes            |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `id`        | `string`                                                                           |                  |
| `title`     | `string`                                                                           |                  |
| `content`   | `string`                                                                           |                  |
| `ownerId`   | `string`                                                                           |                  |
| `acl`       | `{ userId: string; level: "Public" \| "Read" \| "Moderate" \| "Admin" }[] \| null` |                  |
| `createdAt` | `string`                                                                           | format date-time |
| `updatedAt` | `string`                                                                           | format date-time |

## Methods

### `get`

Reads one document.

A query.

Access: `{ service: "Read", entry: "Read" }`: a service-wide grant of Read or more, or Read or more on the row `input.id` names.

Input:

| Field | Type     | Notes                |
| ----- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `id`  | `string` | at least 1 character |

Output: one row as the `entity` projection.

### `list`

Lists the rows the caller can read, a page at a time, filtered and sorted by the declared fields. Pass a page's nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

A query.

Access: `"authenticated"`: any signed-in caller.

Input:

| Field         | Type                                                                            | Notes                |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `filter?`     | `{ ownerId?: string }`                                                          |                      |
| `sort?`       | `{ field: "updatedAt" \| "title" \| "createdAt"; direction?: "asc" \| "desc" }` |                      |
| `cursor?`     | `string`                                                                        | 1 to 4096 characters |
| `limit?`      | `integer`                                                                       | 1 to 200; default 50 |
| `totalCount?` | `boolean`                                                                       |                      |

Output: `{ items: { id: string; title: string; content: string; ownerId: string; acl: { userId: string; level: "Public" | "Read" | "Moderate" | "Admin" }[] | null; createdAt: string; updatedAt: string }[]; nextCursor: string | null; totalCount?: integer }`.

### `create`

Creates a document owned by the caller.

A mutation.

Access: `"authenticated"`: any signed-in caller.

Input:

| Field      | Type     | Notes                     |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `title`    | `string` | 1 to 200 characters       |
| `content?` | `string` | at most 100000 characters |

Output: one row as the `entity` projection.

### `update`

Changes a document's title or content.

A mutation.

Access: `{ service: "Moderate", entry: "Moderate" }`: a service-wide grant of Moderate or more, or Moderate or more on the row `input.id` names.

Input:

| Field      | Type     | Notes                     |
| ---------- | -------- | ------------------------- |
| `id`       | `string` | at least 1 character      |
| `title?`   | `string` | 1 to 200 characters       |
| `content?` | `string` | at most 100000 characters |

Output: one row as the `entity` projection.

### `delete`

Deletes a document.

A mutation.

Access: `{ service: "Admin", entry: "Admin" }`: a service-wide grant of Admin or more, or Admin or more on the row `input.id` names.

Input:

| Field | Type     | Notes                |
| ----- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `id`  | `string` | at least 1 character |

Output: `null`.

### `share`

Gives a user a level on one row: Read, Moderate or Admin. A user the row is shared with already gets the new level.

A mutation.

Access: `{ service: "Admin", entry: "Admin" }`: a service-wide grant of Admin or more, or Admin or more on the row `input.id` names.

Input:

| Field    | Type                              | Notes                |
| -------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `id`     | `string`                          | at least 1 character |
| `userId` | `string`                          | at least 1 character |
| `level`  | `"Read" \| "Moderate" \| "Admin"` |                      |

Output: `{ userId: string; level: "Public" | "Read" | "Moderate" | "Admin" }[]`.

### `unshare`

Takes a user's level on one row away. The owner's cannot be taken away.

A mutation.

Access: `{ service: "Admin", entry: "Admin" }`: a service-wide grant of Admin or more, or Admin or more on the row `input.id` names.

Input:

| Field    | Type     | Notes                |
| -------- | -------- | -------------------- |
| `id`     | `string` | at least 1 character |
| `userId` | `string` | at least 1 character |

Output: `{ userId: string; level: "Public" | "Read" | "Moderate" | "Admin" }[]`.

### `setLevel`

| `sort?`     | `{ field: "updatedAt" \| "title" \| "createdAt"; direction?: "asc" \| "desc" }` |                         |
| `page?`     | `integer`                                                                       | 1 to 1000000; default 1 |
| `pageSize?` | `integer`                                                                       | 1 to 100; default 20    |

Output: `{ items: { id?: string; title?: string; content?: string; ownerId?: string; acl?: { userId: string; level: "Public" | "Read" | "Moderate" | "Admin" }[] | null; createdAt?: string; updatedAt?: string }[]; total: integer; page: integer; pageSize: integer; totalPages: integer }`.
